subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should JSON-shaped assistant text become an executable format by default for every provider using createPlainTextToolCallCompatWrapper, or should providers explicitly opt into it after live proof?
rationale: This changes the boundary between visible model output and executable tool input across several providers, and repository policy treats new fallbacks and provider behavior as an intentional product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Require provider opt-in
options.body: Keep JSON promotion behind an internal provider-owned capability and enable it only where a real provider run proves the need and delivery safety.

options.title: Approve the shared default
options.body: Accept JSON as a default compatibility grammar after live multi-provider proof covers tool promotion, ordinary JSON replay, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep native Ollama only
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if the only confirmed case is an Ollama /v1 setup that should instead use the documented native API.

recommendation.title: Require provider opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep JSON promotion behind an internal provider-owned capability and enable it only where a real provider run proves the need and delivery safety.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared provider-wrapper contract and recent repair integration.
